name: dsh-molbio-tools
description: Zero-dependency molecular-biology plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: sequence analysis, primer design (incl. cross-intron qPCR primers), cloning simulation, SnapGene .dna parsing and plasmid maps, Sanger verification, protein tools, qPCR analysis and plotting, multiple sequence alignment and conservation analysis, and a literature/protocol/experiment record system.
